name: aegiscodex-
stderr:
❌ Invalid arguments:
Unknown argument: stdio

aegis [message] [options]

Commands:
  aegis login           Log in to aegiscloud (Google or username/password), or C
                        laude Code Pro/Max
  aegis logout          Log out and remove stored aegiscloud credentials
  aegis [message..]     Start interactive mode                         [default]

Positionals:
  message  Initial message to send (can be multiple words)              [string]

Debug Options:
  -d, --debug  Enable debug mode                      [boolean] [default: false]

AI Options:
      --api-key    API key for the LLM service                          [string]
      --base-url   Base URL for the API (for OpenAI-compatible services)[string]
  -m, --model      Model to use for the current session                 [string]
      --max-turns  Maximum conversation turns (-1 = unlimited, default: -1)
                                                                        [number]
      --router     Start with the auto-router on — picks a model per message bas
                   ed on task complexity              [boolean] [default: false]

Security Options:
      --permission-mode   Permission mode for tool execution
                               [string] [choices: "default", "autoEdit", "yolo"]
      --yolo              Auto-approve all tool executions (alias for --permissi
                          on-mode=yolo)               [boolean] [default: false]
      --allowed-tools     List of tool names to allow                    [array]
      --disallowed-tools  List of tool names to disallow                 [array]

Session Options:
  -c, --continue  Continue the most recent conversation
                                                      [boolean] [default: false]
  -r, --resume    Resume a specific conversation by ID                  [string]

Output Options:
  -p, --print          Print response and exit (non-interactive mode)
                                                      [boolean] [default: false]
      --output-format  Output format (only with --print)
                            [string] [choices: "text", "json"] [default: "text"]

UI Options:
  -t, --theme  Color theme for the UI (overrides saved preference)
     [string] [choices: "default", "light", "dark", "ocean", "forest", "sunset"]
      --plain  Plain text mode (disable Ink rendering, for non-TTY terminals)
                                                      [boolean] [default: false]

Config Options:
      --init  Create default configuration file       [boolean] [default: false]

Options:
      --version  Show version number                                   [boolean]
  -h, --help     Show help                                             [boolean]

Examples:
  aegis                      Start interactive mode
  aegis login                Log in via browser
  aegis continue             Continue the most recent conversation
  aegis resume <session-id>  Resume a specific conversation by ID
  aegis "帮我分析这个项目"           Start with an initial message
  aegis --model gpt-4        Use a specific model
  aegis --router             Start with the auto-router on
  aegis --debug              Enable debug mode
  aegis --init               Create default config file
